newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil trade seen staying in deficit in 1997-paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil trade seen staying in deficit in 1997-paper.

text.p: Brazilian Planning Minister Antonio Kandir said Brazilian trade will remain in deficit in 1997 and this will probably persist until early 1998, local newspapers reported.
Folha de S. Paulo quoted Kandir as saying Brazil "will continue to have trade deficits in the coming year and possibly even at the start of....," but added he did not finish the sentence.
Kandir, speaking on Tuesday at a business conference, said trade deficits should be expected while a country undergoes economic restructuring and growth due to heavy imports of capital goods.
He said the government aims to boost exports without taking measures to slow down the economy, adding the export-boosting measures should begin to show results by mid-1997.
